command:
import time,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
count=lambda: p.read_text().count('mechanics_time_taken') if p.exists() else 0
initial=count()
deadline=time.monotonic()+120
while count()<initial+30:
 if time.monotonic()>deadline: raise SystemExit('Timed out waiting for gameplay frames')
 time.sleep(.1)
print('30 gameplay frames rendered')
